record.question: Consider the following statements: (i) The UPSC is marking 100 years of its existence. (ii) UPSC owes its origin to the Lee Commission of 1924. (iii) Following the Lee Commission's recommendations, the first Public Service Commission in India was set up on 1.10.2025. (iv) Upon India's independence, the Federal Public Service Commission was renamed the UPSC and gained constitutional status. Which of the following statement(s) is/are correct?
record.explanation: Official final key: C — Only (i), (ii) and (iv). MPSC notification 4 November 2025, examination 9 October 2025, Paper 1 series A, printed Q29, key physical page 1. The final key accepts statements (i), (ii) and (iv). The item refers to the centenary period, not 100 completed years on the examination date. The source prints 1.10.2025 in statement (iii), which is not the establishment date; the false statement is excluded.
